notes: Null values are unknowns, not permission grants.
Approval is limited to the explicit testbed decision; unassigned ownership remains a readiness issue.
Empty applicability on imported frontdoor entries means unspecified, not verified.
requires contains capability IDs, not source technology prerequisites. They are not interchangeable.
Constrained technology objects are conjunctive requirements; constraint '*' requires presence without asserting a version. Plain strings are alternatives.
Captured factory entries have one runtime compatibility label each. Alternative runtime labels need an agreed encoding, not conjunction.
Source discovery type read maps to kind action plus operation read; knowledge maps to kind knowledge. Agent type remains explicit.
Source lifecycle inactive maps to retired; approval is independent.
